limitations: Author-visible synthetic fixtures are policy checks, not blinded/field accuracy or proof of business impact. No production deployment, native UI capture or paid provider evaluation ran.

Material identity changes are limited to allowlisted English daily/weekly/monthly report cadence. Other useful changes can remain suppressed; legacy unknown cadence intentionally suppresses all report variants.
Priority uses related-family user reports, not verified results or proof a new proposal is useful. Decisions and delivery are not outcomes; missing feedback remains explicit.
Feedback metrics read the full retained census; large-database performance has not been benchmarked. Undated legacy flags cannot establish cooldown timing or dated reappearance errors.
Optional F-09/F-10 prepared decision storage is read-compatible, but the complete prepared runtime stack was not combined or enabled. F-11 delivery remains separately gated.
rollback: Disable existing awareness for containment, or restore the previous versioned suppression/ranking policy while retaining Q-11/Q-12 safety/privacy guards, durable identities, feedback and user work. The first report's family storage key protects older-writer deduplication. Never drop tables, erase history or replay effects.
